scope: Credit, if all gates pass, for refuting Conjecture 5.1 for doubled 3-regular graphs with the 18-vertex input: every one of its 25 labelled pure YY-Delta minima (order 11) is chain-free under the faithful illustrated chain definition, yet the chosen G' reaches order 10 by the seven-move witness, so it is not minimal. No separate credit for the seven-move simplification, the incidence repair or the other minima.
significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, modest: a finite computational counterexample to a conjecture in a 2024 journal paper; not a printed gadget with padding and not a source procedure applied to the next catalogue entry (unlike 355701); the authors knew non-chain gadgets reduce arbitrary graphs and conjectured they do not hide in chain-free pure minima of doubled cubic inputs; the counterexample shows such a gadget (Figure 14 (c)/(g)) behind one expansion. The 355701 caution is noted and judged not to apply.
